about_the_game:
Game Features

Narrative-Driven Survival Sandbox
Immerse yourself in a dark, post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge for supplies in a semi-open sandbox, where survival and story go hand in hand.

Dungeon Challenges & Bounty Hunts
Face powerful bosses and hunt down wanted targets in dynamic combat encounters.

Secrets & Exploration
Uncover hidden elements, explore mysterious regions, and piece together the shattered world’s story.

Team Up with 6 Unique Companions
Form your party from six fully-developed characters—each can be befriended, romanced, or killed based on your choices.

Core Gameplay

In the first half, experience a semi-open survival sandbox focused on narrative, exploration, and scavenging—search every drawer and ruin for vital resources (yes, looting is a key mechanic).
As the story progresses, your choices shape everything: who lives, who dies, and how the world ends. Multiple endings await.

Once you enter the final chapter, there's no turning back. Your decisions echo into eternity.
Prepare carefully before each turn-based battle—optimize skills, gear, and synergy for tactical advantage.

Rally Your Companions

You won’t face this journey alone. Your party is filled with unique allies:

  • Nero (20, Tank/Support, Sword/Hammer/Axe): A clumsy but earnest rookie mercenary with a strong body and a brave heart.

  • Peramisu (22, Assassin/Physical DPS, Dagger): A sharp-tongued, elusive veteran with many admirers—and more enemies. Accepts no love but death together.

  • Mino (18, Ranged/Physical DPS, Bow/Crossbow/Whip): A blank-slate boy from a lost civilization, awakened from cryosleep with no memories.

  • Daisy (21, Healer/Support, Staff): A kind but timid nun from the Holy Light Orphanage. Holds immense magical power but fears conflict.

  • Fars (18, Mage/DPS, Grimoire): A self-proclaimed genius in rune arts. Aloof and arrogant on the outside, soft on the inside. Constantly exhausted.

  • Vivian (19, Hybrid Physical/Magic DPS, Scythe): A mysterious spirit-channeler and devout of the War God. A true powerhouse—even Peramisu gives her respect.

Forge bonds, influence their stories, and guide them toward their fate under the golden lamp's final light.

True Turn-Based Combat

Experience deeply strategic turn-based battles. Power up your team, master equipment synergy, and exploit enemy weaknesses with tactical precision.

Branching Storylines & Multiple Endings

Every decision sends ripples through the world. Shape the fate of your companions, and determine the world's salvation—or its ruin.

A Richly Detailed Sandbox World

Each area features unique themes and visuals, intricately connected into an immersive world. Unlock new abilities and zones as you explore, and uncover the truth hidden in the mist.

name: The end of paradise

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core Duo E6600 @ 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel 4400, GeForce GT 8800, AMD Radeon HD 4650
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400s @ 2.5 GHz or AMD FX-6350 @ 3.9 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 280X
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A dark, despair-filled RPG + survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Play as a mercenary survivor in the last paradise. Befriend or kill 6 companions, explore the black mist, face the Old Gods, and choose to save humanity—or end the world.
